//: here): tsconfig.json without the *.test.ts(x) files. Next leaves errors in
test files out of the build's report, so checking them never failed a
build, yet they are about two fifths of the program. With them in, the
check outgrew the 2 GB heap Node gets on 7 GB machines such as the macOS
release runners. Editors and vitest keep using tsconfig.json, tests and all.
`exclude` replaces tsconfig.json's list instead of adding to it, so the
first three entries must stay in step with that file.
